task_description: Add an Activo (habilitar/inhabilitar) flag to Categorias mirroring the existing Productos feature: entity flag + EF migration (defaultValue true), reusable CambiarEstadoRequest DTO, CategoriaDto.Activo, service SetActivoAsync + GetAllAsync(bool? activo), controller optional ?activo filter + PATCH {id}/estado, and a Blazor form-switch + estado filter in Categorias.razor. GET api/categorias must stay all-by-default so the two Productos category dropdowns are unaffected.
